card.name: Abbreviations and Luer-Lok endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a short abbreviation or brand-style term, such as CV after 'cardiovascular (' or the ending of Luer-Lok. It sits inside parentheses or right after a spelled-out term.

modes.label: Abbreviation in parentheses
modes.description: A short capitalized abbreviation such as CV or SC placed in parentheses right after the full term.
modes.example: high cardiovascular (<<CV>>) risk), acute pancreatitis was reported

modes.label: Luer-Lok ending
modes.description: The closing piece of the syringe-connector name Luer-Lok.
modes.example: needle with Luer-L<<ok>> to withdraw the calculated volume of VEO

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated code and foreign-script pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of a short abbreviation, like CV after cardiovascular, or on the end of the name Luer-Lok.
